levels.name: Spiral out
levels.hint: Repeat n walks n steps. Plus one makes the next walk one step longer.

levels.name: Plus goes first
levels.hint: This time the first walk is two steps long. Where should the plus go?

levels.name: Growing stairs
levels.hint: Each drop is one square deeper than the last. Let n count the drop.

levels.name: Giant steps
levels.hint: Each giant step goes n along and n down. Then n grows!

levels.name: Big start
levels.hint: Look at the robot's number before you start. n is 3 this time!

levels.name: Jump by two
levels.hint: n starts at 0, and each walk is two steps longer than the one before.

levels.name: Spiral in
levels.hint: n starts at 5. Minus one makes each walk one step shorter.

levels.name: Countdown stairs
levels.hint: Each drop is one square shorter than the last. Count down with minus.

levels.name: Shrinking steps
levels.hint: Giant steps again, but each one smaller. Plus or minus?

levels.name: Star arms
levels.hint: Each arm is one longer. Walk out to the gem, then back to the middle.

levels.name: Shrinking star
levels.hint: Four arms again, and each one is shorter than the one before.

levels.name: n inside n
levels.hint: One side of 1, two sides of 2, three sides of 3. Repeat n in Repeat n!

levels.name: Grow and shrink
levels.hint: The walks get longer, then shorter. Plus first, then minus.

levels.name: Painted spiral
levels.hint: Paint as you walk. Each side of the spiral is one square longer.

levels.name: Paint inwards
levels.hint: n starts at 6. Paint the spiral from the outside in.

levels.name: Spiral with gaps
levels.hint: Two sides of each length, and each length is two longer.

levels.name: Painted steps
alt: r3(rn(F P) R rn(F P) L +)
levels.hint: F1 can paint a line n long. Use it along and down, then grow n.

levels.name: Bar chart
levels.sol: r4(L rn(F P) R R rn(F) L F F +)
levels.hint: Paint a bar going up, walk back down, move along. Each bar is taller.

levels.name: Sound wave
levels.sol: r3(F L f f R F +)|rn(F P) R R rn(F)
levels.hint: Every column has a bar up and a bar down. F1 can paint one bar.

levels.name: Pyramid
levels.sol: r3(f +) r4(f -)|L rn(F P) R R rn(F) L F
levels.hint: The bars grow, then shrink. Put one bar in F1, then plus, then minus.
